text:
Morgan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A. People asked for tangible evidence we have a defensible serving moat. Can leadership list 3 customer-facing stories or proofs we can use in sales/materials this quarter?
Asha: Three short proofs: 1) Customer X cut per-token spend by 30% after we enabled prefix caching + Optimize profiles; 2) Customer Y required private deployment + KMS and we delivered a 2-week Dedicated onboarding with SLA commitments; 3) Customer Z successfully rolled out an A/B canary using our rollout policies and avoided a quality regression. I'll get anonymized artifacts.
Riley: For comms, can we turn those into 1-sentence case bullets? Marketing needs soundbites for demos and the homepage.
Priya: Suggested bullets: "Verified 30% avg token savings in production workloads", "2-week private deployment path with enterprise SLAs", "Safeguarded rollouts with automatic fallbacks and quality gates." Keep them verifiable.
Diego: Engineering add: include a short graph showing p95 before/after prefix cache for a chat workload. That resonates with infra teams. Zoe in perf can generate it.
Sam: Metrics ask: what quick telemetry can we expose to prove these in-product?
Morgan: Expose three signals: a) estimated tokens saved per customer/month (from cache + batching), b) time-to-first-successful-Dedicated-deploy, c) number of rollbacks prevented by automatic fallback. Product to add these as beta widgets.
Kai: Competitor note: some vendors advertise "drop-in" SDKs. We should avoid that phrase but provide mapping guides + an adapter CLI to lower migration effort without legal risk.
Asha: Agreed. Legal-safe adapter + mapping docs. Also we'll publish reproducible perf scripts so customers can validate ourselves.
InfraBot: Note uploaded: follow-up artifacts and a checklist for the three proofs -> https://confluence.redwood/ah/1823456123
Morgan: Action items: Asha to gather artifacts, Diego + Zoe to produce the p95 graph, Sam to add product widgets, Riley + Priya to draft the marketing bullets. Check-in next Wed.
